# Provenance of plots/figures/

**Everything in this folder is post-fix.** It is regenerated by

```bash
cd "e:/update-single task + videos"
python -m src_continuous_control.plots.make_reinvestigation_figures
```

from `workspace/final2_results/` (the 4-arm × 10-seed sweep run after all fifteen defects were
fixed) plus the Job C/D/F diagnostic arms. Both `.png` and `.pdf` are written.

## Why this note exists

Until 2026-08-06 this folder held figures dated **Jul 26–30**, produced *before* the α_P tuning,
the `decay_mode` fix and the θ_P initialisation fix. They were still tracked, still looked
plausible, and there was nothing on them to say they described a run in which the permanent value
function was effectively inert. Concretely, the old `consolidation_internals_{trained,shipped}`
showed `‖V_trans‖` dropping to ~0.1× of its pre-decay value at every consolidation; the algorithm
specifies λ, and the corrected code measures **0.950 = λ exactly**.

A second folder, `figures_reinvestigation/`, briefly held the post-fix set in parallel. Two folders
is how the stale ones survived, so there is now one.

## Kept in `plots/figures_before_fixes/`, not regenerable here

That folder holds the pre-fix figure set — the figures of the study as it stood before the audit,
which is what `FINDINGS.md` reads. It is tracked, because `FINDINGS.md` links to it and a document
whose figures have silently become someone else's figures is worse than one with dead links.

The ones below have no post-fix counterpart in this folder yet. Each needs data that does not
exist locally:

| figure | what it needs |
|---|---|
| `drift_comparison` | the three drift regimes (slow / two-timescale / fast), never re-run post-fix. |
| `r7_grid` | **nothing — retracted.** It plotted the Theorem 7 retention result, which a permanent frozen at exactly zero also satisfies. It was measuring inertia. Do not regenerate. |
| `consolidation_mechanism` | regenerable locally via `plots/make_consolidation_figure.py`, but its panel (c) argues from `decay_mode="params"`, which is no longer what the agent does. Needs its claims rewritten before it is redrawn. |
| `consolidation_internals_{trained,shipped}` | superseded by `consolidation_prepost`. |

`consolidation_insitu` and `consolidation_loss_curves` were initially listed here as
unrecoverable, because `jobG_results/` and `jobI_results/` had not yet been copied back from the
box. They have been, so both are now generated from source like everything else. The in-situ
figure reports a held-out ÷ fitted absorbed-fraction ratio of **1.001**, which is the measurement
that rules out the transfer being memorisation of the ConsolidationBuffer.

`offline_curves` was the last one blocked, and Job J unblocked it. Its runs reproduce
`final2_results` **bitwise on all 20 of them, over the full 3.07 M steps** — so the evaluation is
genuinely read-only and these curves belong to the same training as every other figure here. That
is also the end-to-end confirmation that defect #14 is dead; the unit test only proved the helper.
